key_insight: Gemini achieved the highest observed accuracy (90.29%), but SVM and the strongest transformer were not statistically distinguishable in this evaluation.
clinical_relevance: Classifying informal Bangla symptom narratives could support specialist referral workflows, though clinical benefit was not evaluated.
method: Compared 6 classical ML models, 4 deep learning models, 4 fine-tuned transformers, and 5 zero-shot LLMs.
Used a shared 80:20 train–test split of 2,730 narratives across the five most represented specialties.
Assessed accuracy, macro-F1, and paired McNemar tests with Holm correction.
evidence_signal: On the shared test set, Gemini led with 90.29% accuracy and 90.15% macro-F1, but its gap over Grok was not significant after correction (adjusted p = 0.104).
watch_item: Restricting evaluation to five of the original 20 specialties limits conclusions about broader referral use.
paper_title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
